name: Cassette AC units
tagline: Four-way airflow from a flush ceiling panel
description: Ceiling-mounted systems designed for even airflow in open rooms, offices, and retail spaces.
long_description: Cassette units fit into a false ceiling, so only a slim grille is visible. Air is thrown in up to four directions from the centre of the room, which avoids the hot and cold spots common with wall units in large spaces. They also free up wall space for shelving, displays and windows.
features: 360° or four-way air distribution for even comfort
Flush ceiling mounting that keeps walls clear
Built-in drain pump for flexible placement
Well suited to showrooms, clinics, restaurants and offices

specs.label: Power supply
specs.value: Single phase up to ~2 TR; three phase for larger models

specs.label: Ceiling requirement
specs.value: False ceiling with about 250 – 300 mm clear depth

specs.label: Drainage
specs.value: Built-in drain pump (lift of about 500 – 850 mm)

considerations: Needs a false ceiling; plan it before ceiling work is finished
Place the unit near the centre of the room for even air throw
Several cassettes can share one large space for better coverage

faqs.question: Can a cassette be fitted in an existing ceiling?
faqs.answer: Yes, if there is enough depth above the ceiling. We cut a panel opening, support the unit from the slab and route piping and drain above the ceiling.

faqs.question: Is a cassette noisier than a split?
faqs.answer: No. Modern cassettes are comparable to wall splits, and the compressor still sits outdoors.
